{"metadata":{"description":"DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: a split grid of live sessions, each cell typable - watch several projects at once","id":"gh:1432301324","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-workspace-split","slug":"metal-huang/dsh-workspace-split","topics":["cordis","cordis-plugin","dashboard","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","multi-project","multi-session","split-view"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: a split grid of live sessions, each cell typable - watch several proj"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"k Harness) plugin: a split grid of live sessions, each cell typable - watch several projects at once"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-workspace-split"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English · 中文说明"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Keep several **live** sessions of DeepSeek Harness side by side and type in any
of them. Built for s"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"upervising several projects at once: you see every session's
progress on one screen instead of click"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"l projects at once: you see every session's
progress on one screen instead of clicking through tabs."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **A grid of live sessions.** Rows and columns are yours to choose, up to 5 × 6.
Each tile holds a "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"running session with its full transcript.
- **Every tile is typable, attachments included.** Each ce"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ll has its own
composer; paste, drop, or pick a PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF, or attach any other
file th"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"rough the `+` menu. Uploads are staged through `ctx.fileUpload` and sent
as file parts with the text"},{"id":"p6s5","text":". The split layout never changes on its own.
- **Model, reasoning effort, and access mode per tile.*"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"* The seat under the
composer reads the same Session projections and Remote catalogs as Chat, and
wr"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"ites through `session.selectModel` / `/permission <preset>`; switching to
full access asks for the s"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"ame risk confirmation.
- **Slash commands and `@` references.** A `/command` line runs through
`sess"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"ion.command` without spending a turn, and `@` lists files and sessions
through the public reference "},{"id":"p6s10","text":"providers before inserting the same plain-text
token Chat uses.
- **Approvals and questions answer i"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"n the tile.** An approval or
`ask_user_question` waiting on that Session replaces the composer with "},{"id":"p6s12","text":"a
compact card; answering calls the same pending object Chat's panel uses.
- **Context occupancy.** "},{"id":"p6s13","text":"The footer shows the same `projected / window` token
reading as Chat, and hides itself when the proj"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"ection is absent.
- **Session or project per tile.** Pin one session, or pin a project and switch
be"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"tween that project's sessions inside the tile; a free tile's picker puts the
project badge on every "},{"id":"p6s16","text":"row (the same badge as the header) and filters by title
or project, with arrow keys and Enter.
- **A"},{"id":"p6s17","text":"rchiving frees the tile.** Archive a session in the sidebar and any tile
holding it lets go as soon "},{"id":"p6s18","text":"as the Host confirms the archive (one update later;
the grid keeps no optimistic copy): a session ti"},{"id":"p6s19","text":"le empties, a project tile only
drops the session and keeps its scope. Archived sessions leave the t"},{"id":"p6s20","text":"ile pickers
and drop resolution, and come back when you unarchive them.
- **Real-time status.** A do"},{"id":"p6s21","text":"t on each title shows whether the session is working,
and a colored project badge before the title k"},{"id":"p6s22","text":"eeps the Session's project
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## How sessions are wired"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Sessions come from the public `ctx.sessions` API (`list`, `retain`, the event
source), and input goe"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"s out through `session.prompt`. Each tile's transcript,
Markdown, tool cards, and composer are rende"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"red by this plugin itself, with
styles built on DSH's theme variables and visual rules so they match"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"is plugin itself, with
styles built on DSH's theme variables and visual rules so they match the app."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Everything DSH-specific is consumed through public services and Remote
namespaces — `ctx.fileUpload`"},{"id":"p9s2","text":", `ctx.uiSession`, `ctx.remote.session`,
`ctx.remote.permissionPresets`, `ctx.remote.fileReferences`"},{"id":"p9s3","text":", and
`ctx.remote.sessionReferenceResolver` — with one deliberate exception: clearing
the completion"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" dot. DSH clears `completionUnread` only for the main view and
exposes no write path, so the tile re"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ads the `uiSession` instance's own
acknowledgement set (`completionUnread` plus `publishStatus()`). "},{"id":"p9s6","text":"The reasoning and
the fallback are in TECH 13.5, and the plugin
moves to the public method as soon a"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"d
the fallback are in TECH 13.5, and the plugin
moves to the public method as soon as DSH ships one."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"`test/dsh-contract.test.js` asserts those methods and type names — the two private
members included "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"— against the installed DSH build, so an upstream rename fails a
gate with the exact missing symbol "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"instead of silently breaking a tile; when the
private members are gone the dot simply stays lit. Set"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" `DSH_CONTRACT_ROOT` to
check another installation; the test skips when no DSH install is present."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** or newer (desktop or web).
- Desktop app or `dsh web`; the same bu"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" **0.2.1-rc.2** or newer (desktop or web).

of the sidebar, next"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"app (or reload the web page). The toggle appears at the bottom

| Choose the grid | Right-c"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"lick that same ⊞ |
| Assign a session | Use a tile's header picker, or drag a session row from the s"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"idebar into the tile |
| Rename a session | The ✎ next to the tile's title |
| Resize text in one ti"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"le | `Ctrl` + wheel over that tile |
